description: This file manages a role cart feature, including storing, retrieving, updating, and removing role metadata in local storage. It defines types, utility functions, and public API functions for interacting with the role cart state.

methods.name: getRoleCartState
methods.description: Reads the role cart state from local storage, with migration from legacy IDs if needed.

methods.name: setRoleCartState
methods.description: Writes the role cart state to local storage.

methods.name: getRoleCartRoles
methods.description: Returns all roles currently in the cart, deduplicated by id.

methods.name: getRoleCartRoleIds
methods.description: Returns an array of role IDs in insertion order.

methods.name: upsertRoleInCart
methods.description: Adds or updates a role in the cart, maintaining insertion order and updating metadata.

methods.name: removeRoleFromCart
methods.description: Removes a role from the cart by its ID.

methods.name: clearRoleCart
methods.description: Clears all roles from the cart.
